findings.label: Repeated config loads in gold argparse
findings.detail: _parse_gold_args calls gold_marts() and allowed_envs(), and process_mart calls _mart_inputs(mart), each independently reloading the full config via config_loader.load_config(). Harmless for a POC CLI invoked once per stage; a single resolved config threaded through would read cleaner if ever revisited.

findings.label: Uploader --env not config-driven
findings.detail: scripts/upload_landing.py keeps choices=["dev"] hardcoded while the two Spark job parsers now read environments from config. Defensible since the plan scoped only the job parsers and the uploader is intentionally boto3/stdlib with no config dependency, but noted as an asymmetry if env-list consistency matters later.
